summary.description: Reliance lists INR21700-RS40 as a 4Ah 21700 cell with at least 40A continuous discharge without an 80°C cutoff and a 70A maximum continuous value. Battery Mooch tested exact RS40 samples and estimated about 40A true continuous current, while identifying the tested cells as pre-production. Production and batch continuity need confirmation; do not promote 70A as a general operating rating. This record preserves exact-model evidence and unresolved revision caveats for the canonical catalog entry.
highlights: Exact model identity is documented; wrapper and revision continuity remain relevant.
The conservative 40A value is supported by Reliance's 10C specification and exact-model vaping testing.
The tested samples were pre-production; a current retailer warns that its cells are intended for protected packs and not e-cigarettes.
Runtime catalog admission is recorded separately from editorial visibility.
The catalog entry retains its measured and specification limits; default visibility remains a separate editorial decision.

claims.statement: The exact product identity is Reliance INR21700-RS40 (INR21700-RS40), as named by the product source and exact-model test.
Reliance lists INR21700-RS40 as a 4Ah 21700 cell with a 70A temperature-limited maximum.

Reliance lists at least 10C continuous discharge without an 80°C cutoff, equivalent to at least 40A for the 4Ah RS40, and Battery Mooch independently estimated about 40A true continuous current from exact pre-production samples.
The exact Reliance INR21700-RS40 has exact-model vaping test coverage.
A current retailer listing offers the exact Reliance RS40 21700 cell individually, supporting commercial availability of the model.
The current 76-entry Steam Engine battery catalog contains no exact Reliance INR21700-RS40 identity.
